integrity: The mathematical claim is proved by a general integer sign inequality; finite exact integer diagnostics are supplementary, not a replacement for proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for symmetric metallic cat automorphisms and the specified isotropic ℓ1 analytic Fourier Hilbert norm; two independent observables, not autocorrelation. General hyperbolic maps/nonlinear deformations unproved. Earlier exact priority not exhaustively excluded.
title: Exact finite-time analytic correlation norms for metallic cat maps
